components.text: HindiPod101 free lessons and beginner pathways, including absolute-beginner and level 1 content, plus audio/video lessons and speaking practice tools.
HindiPod101’s free account also includes weekly free lessons, word-of-the-day content, and audio/dialogue tools for listening practice.
This plan is built around beginner-friendly audio/dialogue practice and free lesson access.

hindi_plan.speaking: Practice greetings and introduce yourself aloud.
hindi_plan.listening: Listen to a short beginner greeting lesson.

hindi_plan.speaking: Say common classroom phrases and numbers.
hindi_plan.listening: Hear numbers and repeat each one.

hindi_plan.speaking: Practice asking and answering “What is your name?” and “How are you?”
hindi_plan.listening: Listen to a short dialogue and shadow it.

hindi_plan.speaking: Describe basic needs: water, food, help, bathroom.
hindi_plan.listening: Listen for key survival phrases and note them.

hindi_plan.speaking: Practice family words and simple possessives.
hindi_plan.listening: Listen to a family-themed beginner audio lesson.

hindi_plan.speaking: Say where you are from and where you live.
hindi_plan.listening: Listen to location and directions phrases.

hindi_plan.speaking: Review all week’s phrases in a 1-minute self-introduction.
hindi_plan.listening: Replay your favorite lesson and catch every known word.
